f.title: Keep product labels consistent with current scientific information and medical treatment
f.statement: It is the manufacturer's responsibility to update product labels to be consistent with current scientific information and medical treatment.

f.title: Have a system and procedures allowing timely label updates when warranted
f.statement: If an update to the product label is warranted, the manufacturer should have a system and procedures in place to allow a timely label update, applying all elements of a pharmacovigilance system.
